                "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c24

                    # c31
                    - >- # c32
                      a

        beta: &m36 # c37
# c38
            # c39
            enabled: false
            # c40

            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                "tags": *m29
                nested: {deep: {'on': true}} #c47
                # c48
        # c49

            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                "tags": *m29 # c53
            #   c54 with words
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #   c57 with words
    settings: {Codex: [{name: 'İstanbul', alias: ' a1 ', max-context-length: 0}, {"name": m1, alias: "", max-context-length: 200000}, {name: '', alias: pro, max-context-length: 272000}]}
    #c58

        #c60

requests: {proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"} #   c77 with words

steps.config:
"port": 8317
"usage-statistics-enabled": false
"save-cooldown-status": false
"logs-max-total-size-mb": 0
"proxy-url": "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
"codex":
  "stream-bootstrap-buffering": false
  "orphan-delegation-compatibility": false
  "stream-bootstrap-timeout": " 5s "
"xai":
  "inject-x-search": true
"api-keys":
  - "key-1"
  - "sk-été"
  - "key-1"
  - "key-3"
"oauth-settings":
  "Codex":
    - "name": "İstanbul"
      "alias": " a1 "
      "max-context-length": 0
    - "name": "m1"
      "alias": ""
      "max-context-length": 200000
    - "name": ""
      "alias": "pro"
      "max-context-length": 272000
"xai-api-key":
  - "api-key": "key-2"
    "base-url": "http://user@"
    "disable-cooling": true
    "request-retry": 2
    "models":
      - "name": "m2"
        "alias": "sol"
        "force-mapping": false
      - "name": "m1"
        "alias": "pro"
        "thinking":
          "min": 1024
          "max": 32768
          "zero-allowed": true
          "dynamic-allowed": false
          "levels":
            - "<high>"
    "alpha-search": true
"vertex-api-key":
  - "api-key": "key-3"
    "proxy-url": ""
    "headers":
      " X-Pad ": "b"
      "X-Team": "a"
    "disable-cooling": false
    "request-retry": 0
    "models":
      - "name": ""
        "alias": "Pro"
      - "name": "gpt-6-sol"
        "alias": " a1 "
  - "api-key": "key-1"
    "prefix": "Team"
"plugins":
  "enabled": true
  "configs":
    "alpha":
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
    "beta":
      "enabled": false
      "priority": 1
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "unix:///run/plugin.sock"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
        "nested":
          "deep":
            "on": true
    "gamma":
      "settings":
        "endpoint": "https://hook.example/run"
        "retries": 0
        "tags":
          - "a"
          - "b c"
"antigravity":
  "connection-pool":
    "enabled": false
    "idle-conn-timeout": "90s"
"devin":
  "sensitive-words":
    - "Orion"
    - "acme"
"x-extension":
  "owner": "ops"
  "notes":
    - "first"
    - "second note"
  "limits":
    "burst": 10

config-version: 8 #c1
#   c16 with words
plugins:
    enabled: true # c17
    # c18
    configs: # c19
        # c20
        alpha:
            settings: # c22
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c24
                # c25
                retries: 0 # c26
                #c27
                #   c28 with words
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                    # c35
        beta:
            # c38
            # c39
            enabled: false # c37
            # c40
            priority: 1 #c41
            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                nested:
                    deep:
                        'on': true
                        # c48
                        # c49
        gamma: #c47
            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
# c76
requests:
    proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
#c78
access: #   c77 with words
    api-keys:
        - key-1
        - 'sk-été'
        - key-1
        - "key-3"
#   c69 with words
# c70
server: # c79
    port: 8317
    discovery:
        service-type: _ai-gateway._tcp
        subtypes:
            - _chat-completions
            - _responses
            - _messages
            - _generate-content
            - _interactions
# c12
observability: # c13
    logs:
        logs-max-total-size-mb: 0
        #   c14 with words
    usage:
        usage-statistics-enabled: false
        redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: 60
# c71
routing: # c72
    cooldown: #   c73 with words
        # c74
        save-cooldown-status: false #c75
        disable-cooling: false
    retry:
        request-retry: 0
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #c58
    providers: # c59
        #c60
        antigravity:
            connection-pool:
                enabled: false
                idle-conn-timeout: '90s'
                # c62
        devin: # c63
            sensitive-words: # c64
                - "Orion" # c65
                # c66
                - acme #c67
                #   c68 with words
                #   c57 with words
        aistudio:
            ws-auth: true
    settings:
        codex:
            - name: İstanbul
              alias: a1
            - name: m1
              max-context-length: 200000
upstream:
    # c2
    xai:
        # c3
        inject-x-search: true # c4
    codex: #   c5 with words
        # c6
        #c7
        stream-bootstrap-buffering: false
        stream-bootstrap-timeout: ' 5s ' #c10
        # c11

        # c8
        orphan-delegation-compatibility: false # c9
credentials:
    concurrency:
        cpa-heartbeat-timeout: 3s
        cpa-cancel-bound: 5s
        reclaim-grace: 5s
        cleanup-interval: 5s
        release-flush-interval: 250ms
        release-max-backoff: 2s
        busy-retry-min: 250ms
        busy-retry-max: 1s
        # c87
        max-limit: 1000000
    in-flight:
        snapshot-interval: 2s
        stale-after: 10s
        max-part-bytes: 262144
        max-part-count: 64
        max-revision-bytes: 16777216
        max-aggregate-groups: 100000
        max-details: 10000
        max-string-bytes: 256
        staging-retention: 1m

# #   c54 with words
# #c80

#     owner: >- #c82
#         ops
#     # c83
#     notes: # c84
#         - first
#         #c85
#         - 'second note'
#     limits: # c86
#         #   c88 with words
#         burst: 10 # c89

config-version: 8 #c1
#   c16 with words
plugins:
    enabled: true # c17
    # c18
    configs: # c19
        # c20
        alpha:
            settings: # c22
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c24
                # c25
                retries: 0 # c26
                #c27
                #   c28 with words
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                    # c35
        beta:
            # c38
            # c39
            enabled: false # c37
            # c40
            priority: 1 #c41
            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                nested:
                    deep:
                        'on': true
                        # c48
                        # c49
        gamma: #c47
            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
# c76
requests:
    proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
#c78
access: #   c77 with words
    api-keys:
        - key-1
        - 'sk-été'
        - key-1
        - "key-3"
#   c69 with words
# c70
server: # c79
    port: 8317
    discovery:
        service-type: _ai-gateway._tcp
        subtypes:
            - _chat-completions
            - _responses
            - _messages
            - _generate-content
            - _interactions
credentials:
    concurrency:
        cpa-heartbeat-timeout: 3s
        cpa-cancel-bound: 5s
        reclaim-grace: 5s
        cleanup-interval: 5s
        release-flush-interval: 250ms
        release-max-backoff: 2s
        busy-retry-min: 250ms
        busy-retry-max: 1s
        # c87
        max-limit: 1000000
    in-flight:
        snapshot-interval: 2s
        stale-after: 10s
        max-part-bytes: 262144
        max-part-count: 64
        max-revision-bytes: 16777216
        max-aggregate-groups: 100000
        max-details: 10000
        max-string-bytes: 256
        staging-retention: 1m
# c12
observability: # c13
    logs:
        logs-max-total-size-mb: 0
        #   c14 with words
    usage:
        usage-statistics-enabled: false
        redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: 60
# c71
routing: # c72
    cooldown: #   c73 with words
        disable-cooling: false
        # c74
        save-cooldown-status: false #c75
    retry:
        request-retry: 0
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #c58
    providers: # c59
        aistudio:
            ws-auth: true
        #c60
        antigravity:
            connection-pool:
                enabled: false
                idle-conn-timeout: '90s'
                # c62
        devin: # c63
            sensitive-words: # c64
                - "Orion" # c65
                # c66
                - acme #c67
                #   c68 with words
                #   c57 with words
    settings:
        codex:
            - name: İstanbul
              alias: a1
            - name: m1
              max-context-length: 200000
upstream:
    # c2
    xai:
        # c3
        inject-x-search: true # c4
    codex: #   c5 with words
        # c6
        #c7
        stream-bootstrap-buffering: false
        stream-bootstrap-timeout: ' 5s ' #c10
        # c11

        # c8
        orphan-delegation-compatibility: false # c9
api-keys:
    vertex:
        - name: vertex-1
          headers:
            X-Pad: b
            X-Team: a
          models:
            - name: gpt-6-sol
              alias: a1
          disable-cooling: false
          request-retry: 0
          keys:
            - api-key: key-3
        - name: vertex-2
          prefix: Team
          keys:
            - api-key: key-1
    xai:
        - name: xai-1
          base-url: http://user@
          models:
            - name: m2
              alias: sol
            - name: m1
              alias: pro
              thinking:
                min: 1024
                max: 32768
                zero-allowed: true
                levels:
                    - <high>
          disable-cooling: true
          request-retry: 2
          keys:
            - api-key: key-2

# #   c54 with words
# #c80
# x-extension: # c81
#     owner: >- #c82
#         ops
#     # c83
#     notes: # c84
#         - first
#         #c85
#         - 'second note'
#     limits: # c86
#         #   c88 with words
#         burst: 10 # c89

    # c18

                # c25
                retries: 0 # c26
                #c27
                #   c28 with words
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                    # c35
        beta:
            # c38
            # c39
            enabled: false # c37
            # c40
            priority: 1 #c41
            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                tags:
                    # c31

                    # c32

                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words

                    deep:
                        'on': true
                        # c48
                        # c49
        gamma: #c47
            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words

requests:
    proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
#c78
access: #   c77 with words
    api-keys:
        - key-1
        - 'sk-été'
        - key-1
        - "key-3"

# c70
server: # c79
    port: 8317
    discovery:
        service-type: _ai-gateway._tcp
        subtypes:
            - _chat-completions
            - _responses
            - _messages
            - _generate-content
            - _interactions
credentials:
    concurrency:
        cpa-heartbeat-timeout: 3s
        cpa-cancel-bound: 5s
        reclaim-grace: 5s
        cleanup-interval: 5s
        release-flush-interval: 250ms
        release-max-backoff: 2s
        busy-retry-min: 250ms
        busy-retry-max: 1s
        # c87
        max-limit: 1000000
    in-flight:
        snapshot-interval: 2s
        stale-after: 10s
        max-part-bytes: 262144
        max-part-count: 64
        max-revision-bytes: 16777216
        max-aggregate-groups: 100000
        max-details: 10000
        max-string-bytes: 256
        staging-retention: 1m
# c12
observability: # c13
    logs:
        logs-max-total-size-mb: 0
        #   c14 with words
    usage:
        usage-statistics-enabled: false
        redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: 60
# c71
routing: # c72
    cooldown: #   c73 with words
        disable-cooling: false
        # c74
        save-cooldown-status: false #c75
    retry:
        request-retry: 0
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #c58
    providers: # c59
        aistudio:
            ws-auth: true
        #c60
        antigravity:
            connection-pool:
                enabled: false
                idle-conn-timeout: '90s'
                # c62
        devin: # c63
            sensitive-words: # c64
                - "Orion" # c65
                # c66
                - acme #c67
                #   c68 with words
                #   c57 with words
    settings:
        codex:
            - name: İstanbul
              alias: a1
            - name: m1
              max-context-length: 200000
upstream:
    # c2
    xai:
        # c3
        inject-x-search: true # c4
    codex: #   c5 with words
        # c6
        #c7
        stream-bootstrap-buffering: false
        stream-bootstrap-timeout: ' 5s ' #c10
        # c11

        # c8
        orphan-delegation-compatibility: false # c9
api-keys:
    vertex:
        - name: vertex-1
          headers:
            X-Pad: b
            X-Team: a
          models:
            - name: gpt-6-sol
              alias: a1
          disable-cooling: false
          request-retry: 0
          keys:
            - api-key: key-3
        - name: vertex-2
          prefix: Team
          keys:
            - api-key: key-1
    xai:
        - name: xai-1
          base-url: http://user@
          models:
            - name: m2
              alias: sol
            - name: m1
              alias: pro
              thinking:
                min: 1024
                max: 32768
                zero-allowed: true
                levels:
                    - <high>
          disable-cooling: true
          request-retry: 2
          keys:
            - api-key: key-2

source_identities.source:
config-version: 8 #c1
#   c16 with words
plugins:
    enabled: true # c17
    # c18
    configs: # c19
        # c20
        alpha:
            settings: # c22
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c24
                # c25
                retries: 0 # c26
                #c27
                #   c28 with words
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                    # c35
        beta:
            # c38
            # c39
            enabled: false # c37
            # c40
            priority: 1 #c41
            # c42
            settings:
                endpoint: "unix:///run/plugin.sock" #c43
                # c44
                'retries': 0 #   c45 with words
                #c46
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
                nested:
                    deep:
                        'on': true
                        # c48
                        # c49
        gamma: #c47
            # c50
            settings:
                endpoint: https://hook.example/run # c51
                #c52
                'retries': 0
                tags:
                    # c31
                    - "a" #c30
                    # c32
                    # c33
                    - 'b c' #   c34 with words
# c76
requests:
    proxy-url: "https://user:pass@secure.example/v1?token=secret"
#c78
access: #   c77 with words
    api-keys:
        - key-1
        - 'sk-été'
        - key-1
        - "key-3"
#   c69 with words
# c70
server: # c79
    port: 8317
    discovery:
        service-type: _ai-gateway._tcp
        subtypes:
            - _chat-completions
            - _responses
            - _messages
            - _generate-content
            - _interactions
credentials:
    concurrency:
        cpa-heartbeat-timeout: 3s
        cpa-cancel-bound: 5s
        reclaim-grace: 5s
        cleanup-interval: 5s
        release-flush-interval: 250ms
        release-max-backoff: 2s
        busy-retry-min: 250ms
        busy-retry-max: 1s
        # c87
        max-limit: 1000000
    in-flight:
        snapshot-interval: 2s
        stale-after: 10s
        max-part-bytes: 262144
        max-part-count: 64
        max-revision-bytes: 16777216
        max-aggregate-groups: 100000
        max-details: 10000
        max-string-bytes: 256
        staging-retention: 1m
# c12
observability: # c13
    logs:
        logs-max-total-size-mb: 0
        #   c14 with words
    usage:
        usage-statistics-enabled: false
        redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: 60
# c71
routing: # c72
    cooldown: #   c73 with words
        disable-cooling: false
        # c74
        save-cooldown-status: false #c75
    retry:
        request-retry: 0
# c55
# c56
oauth:
    #c58
    providers: # c59
        aistudio:
            ws-auth: true
        #c60
        antigravity:
            connection-pool:
                enabled: false
                idle-conn-timeout: '90s'
                # c62
        devin: # c63
            sensitive-words: # c64
                - "Orion" # c65
                # c66
                - acme #c67
                #   c68 with words
                #   c57 with words
    settings:
        codex:
            - name: İstanbul
              alias: a1
            - name: m1
              max-context-length: 200000
upstream:
    # c2
    xai:
        # c3
        inject-x-search: true # c4
    codex: #   c5 with words
        # c6
        #c7
        stream-bootstrap-buffering: false
        stream-bootstrap-timeout: ' 5s ' #c10
        # c11

        # c8
        orphan-delegation-compatibility: false # c9
api-keys:
    vertex:
        - name: vertex-1
          headers:
            X-Pad: b
            X-Team: a
          models:
            - name: gpt-6-sol
              alias: a1
          disable-cooling: false
          request-retry: 0
          keys:
            - api-key: key-3
        - name: vertex-2
          prefix: Team
          keys:
            - api-key: key-1
    xai:
        - name: xai-1
          base-url: http://user@
          models:
            - name: m2
              alias: sol
            - name: m1
              alias: pro
              thinking:
                min: 1024
                max: 32768
                zero-allowed: true
                levels:
                    - <high>
          disable-cooling: true
          request-retry: 2
          keys:
            - api-key: key-2

# #   c54 with words
# #c80
# x-extension: # c81
#     owner: >- #c82
#         ops
#     # c83
#     notes: # c84
#         - first
#         #c85
#         - 'second note'
#     limits: # c86
#         #   c88 with words
#         burst: 10 # c89
